sóma, m.
 —1. éxtract, esp. of certain
species of the Asclepias family, see 70^5N.;
Soma, both literally, and also personified as
a god; as pl. Soma-dranghts;
 —2. the
moon, see 70^5N. [√1su, ‘extráct,’ 1166.]

soma-pā́ [352], a. Soma-drinking; as m.

soma-péya, n. a drinking of Soma; dat.

somyá, a. having to do with Soma, i. e.,
